review_scope: Incremental exact physical-site geometry review for the 2026-07-22 open-seed-v97 construction snapshot.

acceptances.precision_scope: Official Chilean environmental-review representative point for expediente 2162968448, rounded to five decimals with a conservative 50 metre analyst envelope. It is a project/site locator, not a parcel, campus boundary, building footprint, measured centroid, or survey-accuracy claim.
acceptances.decision_basis: The official Region 13 feature returns exactly one record for expediente 2162968448 and names Ampliación Data Center Campus Scala Huechuraba; the normalized project is explicitly linked to the Huechuraba campus. The publisher warns that the representative point does not describe the project's complete spatial extent.

acceptances.precision_scope: Campus-centre point derived deterministically from EPSG:27700 easting 547101 and northing 210080 supplied by the government-hosted KLON-03 site report. It is not a parcel, campus boundary, KLON-03 building centroid or footprint, and the report states no horizontal positional accuracy.
acceptances.decision_basis: The Environment Agency-hosted report identifies the KAO Data Centre at London Road, Harlow, supplies the grid reference used for the campus-centre conversion, and ties its dated physical observations to KLON-03. The project has an explicit parent link to the KAO Data Harlow campus, so the campus point locates the project without claiming KLON-03-specific geometry.
